mapper.select: select * from psi_stock_out where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and out_type='REPAIR' and deleted=0 and (repair_order_id=#{orderId} or (repair_order_id is null and left(remark, char_length(#{prefix}))=#{prefix})) for update
select * from psi_stock_out_item where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and stock_out_id=#{outId} and deleted=0
mapper.update: update psi_stock_out set doc_status='VOID', update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id=#{id} and tenant_id=#{tenantId} and out_type='REPAIR' and doc_status='CONFIRMED' and deleted=0
